prior_train_box_diagnosis.contract_diagnosis: All 24 training PNG foreground bounding boxes match JSON pixel coordinates, including empty images. There are 21 objects and 21 positive cells. Letterbox transforms boxes with images; target wh remains nonzero and normalized by 64. Negative cells have zero box gradient. Center errors remain substantial, while some height logits reach -7.062 and sigmoid suppresses recovery gradients. Objectness and classification learning lowers total loss without establishing box localization. These observations support incomplete optimization rather than annotation, scaling or mask corruption; a single predeclared 1600-step follow-up will test whether more fixed steps suffice.

image_cli_compatibility.coordinate_note: Inference boxes use original-image pixel coordinates after undo_letterbox; AP50 evaluation and SVG use 64x64 letterboxed coordinates. This is validation-image inference, not another test evaluation.

limitations: Short overfit exercise on 24 training images for the fixture; no proof of broad generalization.
Independent synthetic sources do not reproduce real camera, lighting, occlusion or motion variation.
Exact duplicate/source checks cannot establish that near-duplicate real frames are independent.
One box per grid cell; same-cell annotations fail explicitly rather than being dropped.
Checkpoint parity verifies this CPU reload, not cross-device bitwise equality or resumed optimization parity.
AP and runtime describe one fixed run only; no YOLO-version ranking or benchmark claim.
